description: QGD交换变 D35 — 车借d线入侵

intro.popup_en:
Open Files, Practice 7: Control Two Files
After cxd5 in the Queen's Gambit Exchange Variation, the d-file opens completely. White plans Re1 to contest the e-file and Rad1 to double on the d-file, creating lasting pressure on both open files.
intro.popup:
双开放线控制 练亘7

QGD交换变cxd5后
d线完全打开！

白方计划：
Re1争夺e线对应Re8
+Rad1叠压d线！

d线+e线双重控制！

outro.popup_en: Summary: cxd5 and exd5 open the d-file; Re1 contests the e-file, and Rad1 prepares to double on the d-file. Pressure from two open files gives White a durable plan.
outro.popup:
双线控制小结
✅ cxd5 exd5：d线打通
✅ Re1：争夺e线
✅ Rad1：叠压d线计划

核心战略：
d线叠压+e线对峡
→双开放线持久压力！

moves.popup_en: d4 opens with the Queen's Pawn Opening.
cxd5! White chooses the Exchange Variation and begins opening the d-file.
moves.popup:
cxd5！交换变！
d线开始打开

moves.popup_en: ...exd5 recaptures. The d-file is now fully open from d1 to d8.
moves.popup:
exd5回吃
d线全开！
d1到d8完全通畅！

moves.popup_en: O-O! White castles. The rook can now move from f1 to d1 to double on the open d-file.
moves.popup:
O-O入城！
白方Rf1→Rd1即将叠压d线

moves.popup_en: ...Re8! Black occupies the e-file and watches the d-file.
moves.popup:
Re8！黑方占e线
守护e列，监视d线

moves.popup_en: Qc2 develops the queen and supports the planned f3 advance.
...Nf8! Black reroutes the knight toward g6 and f4, seeking active squares.
moves.popup:
Nf8！黑马转移
Nf8→Ng6→Nf4争夺好位置

moves.popup_en: f3! White prepares e4 and prevents Nf6-e4.
moves.popup:
f3！关键手！
为e4推进做基础
同时防止Nf6→e4

moves.popup_en: ...Be6 develops the bishop and defends d5.
Kh1! The king steps into the corner, freeing g1 for a rook and preparing a kingside pawn advance.
moves.popup:
Kh1！王移角！
为g4推进让出g1给车
王翼进攻准备启动！

moves.popup_en: ...Ng6 maneuvers the knight in search of counterplay.
moves.popup:
Ng6机动
黑马寻找反击机会

moves.popup_en: Re1! White contests the e-file against ...Re8. The plan to double on the d-file with Rad1 is ready, giving White pressure on two open files.
moves.popup:
Re1！车争e线！
对应黑方Re8，e线对峡！
Rad1叠压d线计划就绪！

d线+e线双重控制！
